q: The underground part of a plant that absorbs water and minerals is the ____. (P2)
explain: Roots anchor the plant and absorb moisture and nutrients from the soil.
hint: The part of the plant hidden under the ground.

q: The green pigment in plant leaves that absorbs sunlight is ____. (P2)
explain: Chlorophyll gives leaves their green color and captures sunlight for food production.

q: Ice is water in the ____ state. (P2)
explain: When water freezes below 0°C, it turns into solid ice.

q: Steam (water vapour) is water in the ____ state. (P2)
explain: When water boils at 100°C, it evaporates into invisible gas (water vapour).

q: Moving air is called ____. (P2)
explain: Wind is air moving across the earth's surface.

q: Which animal is an AQUATIC animal (lives in water)? (P2)
explain: Fish possess gills and fins adapted specifically for living in water.

q: Which animal can FLY using feathers and wings? (P2)
explain: Eagles are birds with wings and lightweight hollow bones.
hint: Bird of prey in the sky.

q: Which food item helps our body build strong bones and teeth? (P2)
explain: Milk is rich in calcium and vitamin D, essential for bone density.

q: The instrument used to measure body temperature is a ____. (P2)
explain: A clinical thermometer measures body heat in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): What is the chemical formula of pure water?
explain: H₂O is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Which organ pumps blood in the human body?
explain: Heart is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Which gas do humans inhale for cellular respiration?
explain: Oxygen is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Which gas do green plants absorb during photosynthesis?
explain: Carbon dioxide is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): What is the freezing point of pure water at sea level?
explain: 0°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): What is the boiling point of pure water at standard atmospheric pressure?
explain: 100°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The female reproductive cell in humans and animals is the ____.
explain: ovum (egg) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The male reproductive cell in animals is the ____.
explain: sperm is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Animals that eat ONLY plants are called ____.
explain: herbivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Animals that eat ONLY meat and other animals are called ____.
explain: carnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Animals that eat BOTH plants and meat are called ____.
explain: omnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The largest organ of the human body is the ____.
explain: skin is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The framework of bones that supports and protects human organs is the ____.
explain: skeleton is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Sound cannot travel through a ____ because there are no particles to vibrate.
explain: vacuum (empty space) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Which energy is obtained directly from the sun?
explain: Solar energy is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
explain: Jupiter is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): Which planet is famous for its bright, prominent rings?
explain: Saturn is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The process by which seeds begin to sprout and grow into young seedlings is ____.
explain: germination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is ____.
explain: pollination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The loss of water vapour from the leaves of plants through stomata is ____.
explain: transpiration is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The powerhouse organelle inside animal and plant cells that produces energy is the ____.
explain: mitochondrion is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The control center of a biological cell containing genetic DNA is the ____.
explain: nucleus is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The rigid outer protective layer found in plant cells but absent in animal cells is the ____.
explain: cell wall is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The force of attraction between any two masses in the universe is ____.
explain: gravitation is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P2): The measure of how much matter is packed into a given volume is called ____.
explain: density is the scientifically verified fact.
